goals: Executable CPU tokenizer inspection; no model-weight loading or paid inference
Learner worksheet, instructor criteria and honest validation evidence

done_definition.material: Objectives, explained screens/actions, exercise and grading evidence cover the three units
done_definition.runtime: Actual locked tokenizer runs and offline replay; static or stub tests alone do not meet this criterion
done_definition.teaching: Same-session review separate from classroom trial
done_definition.report: Show partial gates honestly, commit all files and exact next action before stopping

checkpoint_policy: Commit coherent checkpoints to the dedicated branch. On resume read PROGRESS.md and production-index.json, verify branch head/design and continue the first unfinished gate; do not reanalyse all academy files.
